catalog.label: workers

catalog.label: payment
catalog.why: Two steps so compensation runs in reverse; charge moves one token, so its compensation is the refund. "A failed payment must refund" is fail_commit after the charge.

catalog.label: payment2
catalog.why: A second order needs a second saga (one saga is one case). Its accounts are shared, so a token link to payment's accounts makes one balance.

catalog.label: orders2
catalog.why: A second queue: out of one into in of the other is a token link (a cospan composite).

catalog.label: workers2
catalog.why: A second pool: its available place can be token-linked to the first pool's.
